author: brossow
releaseNotes: Small fixes. Refresh now respects the login backoff, so a rule that refreshes on a timer can't keep retrying a wrong password against your Rheem account (Save Preferences still retries at once). A unit that drops offline shows online: false with one warning, instead of a 'no unit has this serial' error on every poll, and recovers by itself. A serial number that exactly matches a unit is always selected, even if it also appears inside another unit's id (zoned systems). Thermostat: an unrecognized mode no longer reports as off, units with a separate fan-mode setting no longer flip back to auto after Fan On, and 'medium' works on units that only have Med.Lo and Med.Hi. Water heater (not yet tested on hardware): cool() no longer throws an error, and vacation mode reports the switch as off, matching thermostatMode.
